Description: Validate that all static elements, labels, and payment/shipping information are displayed correctly on the Checkout Overview page.
Pre-conditions:
1. The browser is launched.
2. The user navigates to the application Base URL.
3. The user logs in successfully with a valid account (valid_user).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Cart page.
2. Click "Checkout".
3. Enter valid user details and click "Continue".
4. Verify the presence and text of the following elements:
 a. Page Title ("Checkout: Overview")
b. QTY Label ("QTY")
c. Description Label ("Description")
d. Payment Information Label & Value ("SauceCard #31337")
e. Shipping Information Label & Value ("Free Pony Express Delivery!")
f. Price Total Label
g. Item Total Label (Initial state "$0" if empty, or specific value)
h. Tax Label
i. Total Label
Expected: 1. All labels and information text match the expected static values.

Test Title: Validate that the Total Price of Order is Correctly Calculated
Description: Validate the mathematical logic for the order total. It ensures the sum of individual item prices equals the Subtotal, and Subtotal + Tax equals the Final Total.
Steps:
1. Add a product (first_Order) to the cart.
2. Proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
3. Subtotal Calculation: Iterate through all item prices in the list, sum them up, and compare with the displayed "Item total".
4. Total Calculation: Add the displayed "Tax" amount to the calculated Subtotal.
5. Compare the result with the displayed "Total" amount.
Expected:
1. Displayed Subtotal matches the sum of item prices.
2. Displayed Total matches Subtotal + Tax.

Test Title: Verify User reached the "Checkout: Complete" Page
Description: Validate the flow from Overview to Completion using the "Finish" button
Steps:
1. Perform a complete checkout flow (Add item -> Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview).
2. Click the "Finish" button.
Expected: 1. The Checkout Complete page title is visible.

Test Title: Verify Cancel Button Redirects to Inventory Page
Description: Validate that clicking "Cancel" on the Overview page abandons the checkout and returns the user to the inventory.
Steps:
1. Add a product and proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
2. Click the "Cancel" button.
Expected:
1. The URL contains /inventory.html.
2. The Product page title "Products" is visible.

Test Title: Verify Navigation to Item Details from Overview Page
Description: Validate that clicking a product name in the overview list navigates to its details page, and the user can return.
Steps:
1. Add a product and proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
2. Click on the name of the first product in the list.
3. Verify URL contains /inventory-item.html.
4. Click the "Back to products" button.
Expected: 1. User is redirected to the Inventory page (/inventory.html).

Test Title: Verify Tax Rate is calculated correctly (approx 8%)
Description: Validate the business logic for tax calculation.
Steps:
1. Add a product and proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
2. Capture the "Item total" value.
3. Capture the "Tax" value.
4. Calculate 8% of the Item total.
Expected: 1. The displayed Tax equals the calculated 8% value (fixed to 2 decimal places).

Test Title: Verify Cart Badge matches the number of items in the Overview list
Description: Validate consistency between the shopping cart badge count and the actual items listed on the overview page.
Steps:
1. Add a product and proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
2. Count the number of item rows in the overview list.
3. Get the text from the shopping cart badge.
Expected: 1. The badge count matches the number of items in the list.

Test Title: Verify Overview Page retains state after reload
Description: Validate that the checkout session persists if the page is refreshed.
Steps:
1. Add a product and proceed to the Checkout Overview page.
2. Reload the browser page.
Expected:
1. The page title remains "Checkout: Overview".
2. The order items are still present in the list.
